verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a programmatic API for managing datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys, plus a downloadable OpenAPI spec. This lets users script operations across many items, but there is no evidence of native bulk endpoints or batch actions. The MCP server's ability to translate existing dashboards and alerts suggests some multi-item agent workflows, but this is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: native bulk/batch API endpoints or UI multi-select actions, documented bulk edit/delete of triggers/SLOs/boards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
